summary: Cleanest rotation of the cycle: capital left the AI-semiconductor complex (XLK -1.07%, NDX sole red index) for healthcare, hard assets and crypto. Moderna +176.97% on the first-ever Phase 3 mRNA cancer-vaccine win (MRK +12.60%, NBI record) led a 14-of-20 biotech RS takeover. Treasury doubled long-end buybacks, cutting the 30yr yield off a 19-year high and fuelling gold +3.86% / silver +5.87% and a crypto rally (IBIT +5.96%, ETHA +9.97%) on the SEC's Regulation Crypto Assets proposal. Breadth positive on all four indices with VIX -6% confirms rotation, not de-risking.
